genius.notes: Moneta terms section 2.1 expressly state its intention to obtain and maintain permitted payment stablecoin issuer status within the legally required timeframes. This supports issuer-announced-intent, not filed application or authorization. No specific federal or state PPSI route is named, so issuerPathway remains unknown. FinCEN MSB registration and NBX Norwegian EMI/CASP authorization describe existing regulatory frameworks, not GENIUS approval. The retained combined issuerEntity denotes parallel issuers, not co-issuance: current NBX whitepaper says separate reserves, no cross-liability, issuer-attributed redemption, and no NBX funding of Moneta redemptions before settled Moneta funds arrive. Moneta transparency provides issuer-reported live reserve balances/composition; a third-party reserve oracle is not a monthly independent accounting attestation. The former Charli3 URL failed the verifier static fetch and is replaced with the working Moneta disclosure. The independently reopened Finanstilsynet browser record confirms NBX EMI registration on January 22, 2024 and CASP registration on June 29, 2026; those institutional licences do not establish a U.S. GENIUS authorization. Foreign exception remains unknown for the NBX branch; not-yet-restricted reflects GENIUS timing, not other applicable-law permissions.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-07, the opened federal proposals, SCRC certification procedure, state licensing list, issuer disclosures and targeted regulator-domain searches did not establish an issuer-specific GENIUS PPSI approval, state qualification, or registered foreign exception for Moneta Digital LLC and Norwegian Block Exchange AS. Licensing or registration under earlier regimes is not such authorization. No public GENIUS-specific enforcement action was located in the checked sources; this is a bounded public-evidence review, not a legal compliance finding.
